description:
Cast Eye of Ramos by paying its mana cost.
When Eye of Ramos enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Eye of Ramos.
Activate Eye of Ramos by sacrificing it.
Haru triggers, returning Eye of Ramos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
